step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows Qonto's PCI-DSS compliant card management system and egress proxy setup. Users send requests from the Mobile App to API Gateway, which triggers a Lambda function. Lambda retrieves encrypted secrets/certificates from AWS Systems Manager (Parameter Store) which uses KMS for decryption. Lambda then communicates with the Mastercard network. Additionally, for application logging and SaaS access (Sentry), traffic flows through a whitelisted internet proxy infrastructure (ELB, EC2, NAT Gateway) to Sentry.

graph.name: Qonto PCI DSS Compliant Architecture for Card Management
graph.notes: Qonto handles card management functions within PCI-DSS certified AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway) and routes egress SaaS logging traffic through a whitelisted proxy cluster on EC2/NAT Gateway to Sentry.

nodes.name: Mobile App
nodes.notes: Qonto mobile application used by customers to manage physical and virtual credit cards.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Receives web service calls from the mobile application.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: PCI-DSS certified serverless compute executing business logic and card processing.

nodes.name: Systems Manager
nodes.notes: Stores secrets and electronic certificates required by Lambda at startup.

nodes.name: KMS
nodes.notes: Encrypts and decrypts secrets stored in Systems Manager.

nodes.name: Mastercard
nodes.notes: External payment network for authorizing card actions.

nodes.name: ELB
nodes.notes: Load balancing tier for internal egress proxy services.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: Runs proxy solution with whitelist capabilities to filter internet traffic.

nodes.name: NAT
nodes.notes: NAT Gateway managing outbound network connections.

nodes.name: Sentry
nodes.notes: External SaaS platform used for application logging and monitoring.

edges.notes: User triggers card management operation from Mobile App to API Gateway.
Lambda fetches secrets and electronic certificates from Systems Manager at startup.
Systems Manager uses KMS to decrypt stored parameters.
Lambda sends authenticated card requests to Mastercard network.
Mastercard returns card processing response to Lambda.
Lambda returns verified and signed response to API Gateway.
API Gateway returns final response to Mobile App.
Lambda routes outbound logging traffic through EC2 proxy.
API Gateway routes outbound proxy traffic via Load Balancer.
NAT Gateway routes whitelisted egress log data to Sentry SaaS.
